facts.text: Deborah encourages Jolene to find joy in the journey and supports her goals.

evidence.quote: Come on! The journey's as important as the destination. Take time for yourself and find joy in it. We believe in you!
Reach for your goals and don't forget to enjoy the journey.

facts.text: Jolene acknowledges Deborah's advice and expresses gratitude for her support.

evidence.quote: Yeah, you're right! I'll take your advice and find joy on the way. Cheers for the support!
Thanks, Deb. Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing forward and remember to enjoy every step of the way.

facts.text: Deborah reassures Jolene that she will always be by her side.
